changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Set the pair key of every one-to-one chat with two participants and merge the chats of a pair that exist more than once.

rollback.stop: The merged duplicate one-to-one chats cannot be split again. Restore the database backup taken before this migration to recover them. A version of Artemis that does not know the pair key can run against the merged data.

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: At most one one-to-one chat per pair of users and course. Chats without a key are not constrained.
